# <span id="aanchor305"></span> Application Usage

The Application Usage screen provides an overview of your specific data, including a breakdown of gas and liquid meters, locations, average tickets for the last 12 months, and quality sources.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 649;height: 298;" />

#### Data Sources

Data in the Application Usage screen is derived as follows:

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Gas">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Gas Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Gas">

- **Active** - Gas meters with a status of Active for the current system date
- **Inactive** - Gas meters with a status of Inactive for the current system date
- **Physical** - Total active and inactive meters
- **Calculated** - Total gas calculated meters
- **Total Meters** - Sum of Physical and Calculated totals

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Liquid">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Liquid Meters</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Liquid">

- **Active** - Liquid meters with a status of Active for the current system date
- **Inactive** - Liquid meters with a status of Inactive for the current system date
- **Physical** - Total active and inactive meters
- **Calculated** - Total liquid calculated meters
- **Total Meters** - Sum of Physical and Calculated totals

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Locations">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Locations</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Locations">

- **Balances** - Total balance locations (created in the Location Editor)
- **Liquid Caverns** - Total liquid caverns (created in the Liquid Cavern Editor)
- **Comparisons** - Total comparison locations (created in the Comparison Editor)
- **Inventories** - Total gas/liquid inventory locations (created in the Location Editor) and gas inventories (created in the Inventory Editor)
- **Segments** - Total segment locations (created in the Location Editor)
- **Stations** - Total station locations (created in the Location Editor)
- **Tanks** - Total tanks (created in the Tank Editor)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Tickets">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Tickets</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Tickets">

- **Attached Count** - Monthly average of tickets attached to a location over the last 12 months (does not include the current month)
- **Standalone Count** - Monthly average of tickets not attached to a location over the last 12 months (does not include the current month)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Sources">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Quality Sources</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Sources">

- **Gas Count** - Total GQ sources (created in the Gas Quality Source Editor)
- **Liquid Count** - Total LQ sources (created in the Liquid Quality Source Editor)

</div>

</div>
